package.name: om6dof_dd_gng
package.description: DD-GNG topology for OM6DOF: an environment graph (Dynamic Growing Neural Gas over RealSense D405 depth, learned in the world frame) and a constant robot-body graph read from TF, published as RViz MarkerArrays. Also still ships the legacy realsense_ddgng/ Python + shared-library tooling and the optional DepthSensor_Buggy visualizer as a plain CMake sub-build; see README.md.
